from xml.dom import minidom
	
	group = value or 'material'
	
	icons = []
	address = self.session.props.gateway.address

	res = system.net.httpGet("%s/data/perspective/icons/%s.svg" % (address, group), bypassCertValidation=True)
	doc = minidom.parseString(res)
	for g in doc.getElementsByTagName("g"):
		if g.hasAttribute("id"):
			icons.append({"path": '%s/%s' % (group, g.getAttribute("id"))})
	
	return icons
